With its [1.9 billion global users](https://seo.ai/blog/how-many-users-on-tiktok) and 170 million monthly active users in the United States only, TikTok has become a major player for advertisers looking for digital marketing success. It’s where millions of people are spending their time and where brands have the potential to connect with their target audience like never before.

As more and more marketers turn to [TikTok for advertising](https://leadsbridge.com/blog/tiktok-advertising/), the need for effective ad optimization strategies is greater than ever. In this article, we’ll explore the world of TikTok Ads optimization and share some of the **most effective strategies and tips** to help you get the most out of your ad spend and stay ahead of the competition.

From using automation with [**LeadsBridge TikTok integrations**](https://leadsbridge.com/blog/tiktok-integrations/) to keeping up with the latest platform updates, we’ll cover everything you need to know to succeed in 2025.

## What is TikTok Ads optimization?

TikTok Ads optimization is all about **fine-tuning your** [**advertising game plan**](https://leadsbridge.com/blog/tiktok-ads-strategy/) to get the most out of your efforts and investment. That means tweaking your ad content, targeting the right audience, and managing your budget to hit your campaign goals.

When you optimize effectively, you **make sure your ads are reaching the people who matter most**, at the right moment.

## Why TikTok Ads optimization is essential

Making the most of TikTok Ads helps you reach your marketing goals more efficiently. Whether you’re looking to boost brand recognition, channel traffic, or boost sales, **optimization is key to ensuring your ads are delivering peak performance**. This, in turn, leads to a better ROI and a more effective advertising campaign.

### The role of data in optimization

Data is your ally in the quest for the perfect TikTok ad. By monitoring numbers like click-through rates (CTR), conversion rates, and engagement, you can **see what’s hitting the mark and what’s not**. This evidence-based strategy empowers you to make smart moves that boost your ad’s impact and cost-effectiveness.

### Staying ahead of the competition

In a market that’s always on the move, fine-tuning your TikTok ads can be a game-changer. By **keeping your strategies sharp**, you’re not just keeping pace – you’re pulling ahead and reaching more of the people you’re after. And in the world of social media ads, that’s a pretty big deal.

### Enhancing user experience

TikTok Ads optimization also plays a role in enhancing user experience. By displaying ads that are pertinent and appealing, you can **boost user satisfaction and diminish** [**ad fatigue**](https://www.webfx.com/blog/marketing/what-is-ad-fatigue/#:~:text=Ad%20fatigue%20is%20when%20your,return%20on%20investment%20\(ROI\).). This, in turn, increases the chances of conversions and cultivates a positive brand image, which is crucial for building lasting customer loyalty and trust.

![](https://leadsbridge.kinsta.cloud/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/collabstr-0Vk7HEjWLDE-unsplash-1-1-1024x683.jpg)

## TikTok’s ban in the US

TikTok, owned by China’s ByteDance, has faced [significant challenges](https://leadsbridge.com/blog/tiktok-banned-in-us/) in the United States due to **national security concerns**. The US government has expressed apprehensions about potential data access and influence by the Chinese government through the app.

### Legislative actions and legal proceedings

*   [**Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act (PAFACA)**](https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/7521): In April 2024, the US Congress passed PAFACA, mandating that foreign adversary-controlled applications like TikTok either divest their US operations or face a ban. This legislation required ByteDance to sell its US TikTok operations by January 19, 2025.
*   **Supreme Court ruling**: ByteDance challenged PAFACA, but on January 17, 2025, the Supreme Court upheld the law’s constitutionality, emphasizing national security concerns over potential data misuse and content influence.

### Implementation of the ban

*   **Service interruption**: On January 18, 2025, TikTok suspended its services in the US in compliance with the impending ban.
*   **Executive intervention**: Following his inauguration on January 20, 2025, President Donald Trump issued an executive order granting a 75-day extension for ByteDance to divest TikTok’s US operations. This move temporarily lifted the ban, allowing TikTok to resume services in the country.

### Current status and prospective developments

*   **Potential sale**: As of March 2025, discussions are ongoing with [four potential US buyers](https://www.reuters.com/technology/trump-says-us-talking-four-different-groups-sale-tiktok-2025-03-10/) interested in acquiring TikTok’s US operations. President Trump has expressed optimism about these negotiations and has indicated a willingness to extend the deadline further if necessary to facilitate a successful transaction.
*   **Operational continuity**: Despite the challenges, TikTok continues to operate in the US under the temporary extension, pending the outcome of the divestment negotiations.

### Impact on advertisers

*   **Staying vigilant**: The potential ban has left many marketers who have invested heavily in TikTok ads in a state of uncertainty. Yet, the platform’s extensive user base and high engagement rates have solidified its position as a valuable advertising avenue. Marketers should be vigilantly tracking the situation and getting ready for any potential outcomes.

In the last five years, TikTok has **witnessed a rapid growth** in the number of users signing up on the platform. 

With its rising popularity, TikTok has presented a unique opportunity for brands who want to **connect with their target audience** on the platform.

Have you been thinking about joining the trend but can’t seem to figure it out?

We feel you!

We created this guide to show you how to advertise on TikTok successfully.

More precisely, we’ll cover:

*   Why having a TikTok ad strategy is important
*   Types of TikTok ads
*   Best practices 

In addition to that, we have a FAQ section you can go through for more clarity. 

Let’s get TikToking! 

## What’s a TikTok Ad Strategy & Why is it Important?

A **TikTok ad strategy** is a detailed plan designed to **persuade your target audience into choosing your product or service** over that of your competitors using ads. In other words, it's creating and running ads on TikTok with an objective in mind. 

So, what are TikTok ads?

They are primarily **sponsored videos** that brands create to reach their audience. 

And running ads on the video-sharing app is an **effective marketing strategy for your business**. 

We’re not just saying that! 

‍

You see, there’s a reason why the hashtag [#tiktokmademebuyit](https://www.tiktokforbusinesseurope.com/news/tiktokmademebuyit-the-power-of-community-reviews) keeps trending with the number of monthly active users increasing. Because it keeps generating views and driving sales. 

Plus, [24% of marketers](https://www.hootsuite.com/research/social-trends) in a 2022 social trends survey considered TikTok as a viable option for them to reach their marketing goals compared to 3% the previous year. That’s like a 700% increase in less than 24 months!

To give you a better idea, TikTok ads can help your business to:

*   Increase brand awareness
*   Build online communities
*   Provide customer service
*   Advertise your products or services to your customers
*   Increase sales or app installs

Similar to other social media platforms, to start marketing your product or service on TikTok, you need to begin by **creating a plan**. In this case, it’s the ad strategy.

Why is having a TikTok ad strategy important?

It can **make a huge difference to the results of your marketing campaign** so you get value for your money.

Also considering the advertising potential on TikTok with the [number of users exceeding 1 billion](https://newsroom.tiktok.com/en-us/1-billion-people-on-tiktok) and expected to keep growing, having an ad strategy will help you reach out to the right people.

If your target audience and TikTok’s user demographics overlap, you can be certain that your brand’s marketing campaign will produce the right type of results. 

Keep in mind that the ad strategy for each marketing campaign has to be unique and you can do that through ad testing.

Now, how about we look at **different types of TikTok ads** so you can figure out which will work best for your ad strategy?

## 7 Types of TikTok Ads (& Which Ones Work Best)

Creating an ad strategy involves a lot of creativity – you’ll need to understand your campaign objectives, target audience, and what type of ads they’ll love. 

But TikTok ads are videos; won’t any type of video do?

Well, they would but at the same time you want to see your returns on ad spend, right?

If so, then you don’t want to leave your ad campaign to chance as **choosing the right format with your goals in mind** can determine how successful your campaign will be. 

There are **various types of TikTok ads** you can use when creating an ad campaign. 

Each serves a unique purpose and suits a variety of campaign objectives. 

We’ll discuss them in a jiffy – so you know which one works best.

### **1\. Top View Ads**

TopView ads is a full-screen 60-second video that offers an **immersive viewing experience for users**. ​

​This ad format presents your brand in an unmissable format so that it **captures the user’s attention** the moment they open the video app. 

Wanna know what’s more interesting?

It has **no other content competing** when it’s on display so nothing interrupts your audience while they are viewing it. 

‍

Plus, you are guaranteed millions of views within 24 hours of launching it. 

TopView ads, according to TikTok, are more engaging and more attention-grabbing with over [70% of users](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en/apps/tiktok) confirming that.

FYP, cheugy, and Charli D’Amelio — welcome to the world of [TikTok](https://www.adroll.com/blog/how-to-use-tiktok-marketing-for-your-business)! With more than [one billion](https://influencermarketinghub.com/tiktok-stats/) monthly active users, this social platform continues to dominate headlines everywhere with new trends like [expensive bucket hats](https://www.distractify.com/p/prada-bucket-challenge-tiktok), [security-related controversies](https://www.cnn.com/2020/07/09/tech/tiktok-security-threat/index.html), and random bits like [TikTok Couch Guy](https://www.vox.com/the-goods/22716772/couch-guy-tiktok-explained).

For marketers lacking a grasp on Gen Z’s strange humor and behaviors, TikTok can feel like an impossible minefield to navigate. But it’s clear brands cannot afford to ignore this platform, especially if they’re targeting younger shoppers. 

From Zara to Glossier, BMW to Chipotle, retailers both large and small are impressing users and driving sales with creativity and casual bravado. 

That said, here’s everything you should know about launching awesome TikTok ads. _Psst_: For more answers to your other marketing questions, [check out this guide](https://www.adroll.com/blog/shopify-plus-merchants-your-top-marketing-questions-in-2021-answered).

## Top TikTok Marketing Tips and Tricks:

*   **Don’t drag on.** TikTok is all about delivering an endless stream of short, punchy content to keep users captivated. That’s why we recommend developing ads shorter than 20 seconds. 
    
*   **Cast a wide audience net.** The more people you reach, the more likely you’ll capture someone’s attention to a point where they’ll want to learn more. With the app skewing toward younger audiences, you’re better off without age targeting. 
    
*   **Get creative.** TikTok isn’t Instagram, so don’t go for a perfectly executed photoshoot or styled video. Experiment with video ideas, try different angles and shot compositions, test out strange filters, and hop on a trending dance or video format. The last thing you want is for users to label your brand as cheugy. (Google it.)
    
*   **Just do it.** Rather than spending hours developing the perfect ad, it’s better to launch and then iterate on TikTok. Don’t be afraid to try different ideas and see which one resonates best with your audience. Then double down on it.

# Our Top Tips For Making Tiktok Ads Work For Your Brand

![](/img/asset/YXNzZXRzL2FtYmVyX211a2Vya2VyLmpwZw/amber_mukerker.jpg?w=100&h=100&s=700c4639ba642a1d5a8a53b113703d1b)

by Amber Mukerker

25/01/2022 5 min read

Are you running [social ads](https://www.evoluted.net/grow/paid-social), but so far you've only tested [Facebook](https://www.evoluted.net/grow/paid-social/facebook-ads) and [Instagram](https://www.evoluted.net/grow/paid-social/instagram-ads)? TikTok ads might be the next step for you to expand your paid advertising efforts. Tiktok is one of the fastest-growing social media platforms out there, and in 2021, it hit [1 billion monthly users](https://www.forbes.com/sites/marisadellatto/2021/09/27/tiktok-hits-1-billion-monthly-active-users/), meaning that it's not a platform you want to sleep on. 

This blog will take you through some pointers for creating successful [TikTok ads](https://www.evoluted.net/grow/paid-social/tiktok-ads), and will cover ad creative tips, working with influencers, and cross-posting TikTok creative across other platforms.

![](/img/asset/YXNzZXRzL3NvbGVuLWZleWlzc2EtMXMxdzFjNF92eWEtdW5zcGxhc2guanBlZw/solen-feyissa-1s1w1c4_vya-unsplash.jpeg?w=5539&h=3693&s=6df66139e554abe6b8ebfe2e1e261429)

## **TIKTOK AD CREATIVE**

One of the most important aspects of running successful TikTok ads is the ad creative you use! Unlike other advertising platforms, TikTok relies heavily on video content, specifically video content that feels authentic and not like an ad. 

Here are our tips for designing killer video creative:

### **MAKE IT LOOK ORGANIC**

Make ads that don’t look like ads by using native TikTok elements, such as text overlays, text-to-speech, and visual effects. This will make your content blend into your audiences' feeds seamlessly. 

### **HOOK VIEWERS QUICKLY**

The first few seconds of your video are the most important for grabbing your audience and preventing them from scrolling on by, so make sure they really pack a punch!

### **USE THE RIGHT AUDIO**

Be sure to only use non-copyright audio to avoid ad disapprovals. [The TikTok Audio Library](https://ads.tiktok.com/business/creativecenter/music/pc/en?rid=yua5c5ubxvj) is the best place to find this. On videos where the audio is speech, don’t forget to use captions to ensure they are accessible.

### **KEEP YOUR CREATIVE SPECS IN MIND**

When making TikTok creative, remember that you need your videos to be shot vertically so that your content isn't masked, and take care to keep your captions and overlays in 'safe zones' so that they aren't hidden by where your caption, profile picture, and like/comment/share buttons are. 

### **TEST, TEST, TEST!** 

TikTok trends come and go, so don’t be afraid to experiment with your content styles. Try out new trends, effects, filming styles, transitions, etc. Ads can fatigue pretty quickly on the platform, so we recommend updating your videos frequently (if you have the capacity to make them, a new video a week works well!) 

### **STAY INSPIRED**

We know it doesn’t take much convincing to scroll through TikTok, but this is the best research tool you can use! Keep up to date with what’s trending and be inspired (and nosey) at what other brands are running. You can view the top ads on the platform through the [TikTok Creative Centre](https://ads.tiktok.com/business/creativecenter/), where you can filter by country, industry, and campaign objective.

## **TIKTOK CREATOR MARKETPLACE / SPARK ADS**

We know that creating consistent content isn’t always viable in-house, therefore you might want to consider using Spark Ads. Spark Ads allows you to reach out to TikTok content creators to run a post of theirs through your ad account.   

The [TikTok Creator Marketplace](https://creatormarketplace.tiktok.com/) is the best place to go through the whole process. On the platform, you can search for relevant creators, create outreach campaigns, approve the creator's content and link their post with your ad account. 

Spark Ads show under the creator's handle, however, through the ad platform, you can add a call to action and relevant landing page for the ad through to your website. 

The creator will allocate an authorisation period, which will determine how long you can use the creator's video. Once set up in your ad account, you will track the ad's performance as you would with any normal ad! 

## **CROSS PLATFORM CONTENT**

Once you’ve started creating your TikTok ad content, you can also use these videos across other platforms. One easy way to repurpose your content is to use it as an Instagram Reel as Reels thrives on content very similar to that of Tiktok. You can also use your videos for other placements such as Facebook/Instagram feeds and stories. 

We highly recommend giving this a go in your account, however, it doesn’t really work the other way round. If you’re using Facebook and Instagram ads, you might be tempted to just use the content from these platforms on TikTok, but don’t! If a TikTok user sees content that doesn’t look like typical TikTok content, they’re a lot more likely to keep scrolling. This is why TikTok's advertising platform emphasises ‘Make TikToks, Not Ads’.

## **3 AD CREATIVE IDEAS TO GET STARTED WITH**

If you’re now ready to start creating TikTok Ads, you might need some ideas on where to even start. Here are a few ideas to get the creativity flowing, focusing on e-commerce:

*   Film a product unboxing/first impressions video of your product.
    
*   Work with a content creator and create a Spark Ad! For example, send them your best selling product and ask them to review it. 
    
*   Do a ‘how to’ style video with your product. For example, if you sell clothing items, create a video showing how to style this season’s pieces.
